head_height.value: 31-36mm from chin to crown of head

file_spec.value: JPEG/JPG format, minimum 420 x 540 pixels, max 4MB

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, no smiling or frowning, mouth closed

glasses_policy.value: Non-tinted prescription glasses allowed if eyes are clearly visible and frame does not cover any part of eyes; sunglasses not acceptable

face_visibility.value: Full front view of head; face in middle of photograph; hair must be off face so edges of face are visible; eyes clearly visible with no glare on lenses

headwear_policy.value: Head coverings allowed for religious reasons if full facial features are not obscured; medical headwear permitted with explanatory letter

size.evidence: The official canada.ca URL returned HTTP 403 but multiple independent sources unanimously confirm the Canadian passport photo size as 50mm wide x 70mm high (2 inches x 2.75 inches). Sources include passlens.com, visapicpro.com, citizenpass.ca, 2x2passportphoto.com, photopass.ai, and passportphotomaker.app -- all citing IRCC requirements and listing 50x70mm / 2x2.75 inches for 2026. The claimed dimensions are correct.
